title: Techno-economic and life-cycle assessment for syngas production using sustainable plasma-assisted methane reforming technologies
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,6043-6062
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05129G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marc Escribà-Gelonch, Jose Osorio-Tejada, Le Yu, Bart Wanten, Annemie Bogaerts, Volker Hessel
This study assesses the techno-economic and environmental viability of plasma-assisted methane reforming for syngas production, finding oxy-CO2 reforming the most effective and bi-reforming promising for clean, cost-efficient syngas production.
